title: How to Get Started with NayaNET

intelligence.title: How to Get Started with NayaNET
intelligence.essence: Getting started with NayaNET takes five minutes: order Naya Power (free to try), receive activation documents, create a free GitHub account, fork the repo, tell Muse or ChatGPT to activate it, complete hub activation, connect GitHub. Zero technical skill required. Identity stays private by default (alias); wisdom is what gets shared.
